title: TD Games B2B Lead Discovery Pipeline
summary: Automated B2B pipeline for 278+ Game Studios. 4 scripts: data_cleaning → email_discovery_bot (web scraping + Google CSE + SalesQL enrichment + SMTP verify) → export_excel. Features: 3-tier contact prioritization (Art Director > Producer > CEO), separated Work/Personal email columns, batch processing (20/batch) with resume, real-time CSV persistence. Codebase at e:\TDC_App\TDGAMES_App\Client_Data\. APIs: SalesQL (enrichment), Google Custom Search (LinkedIn discovery). Dependencies: pandas, requests, beautifulsoup4, openpyxl, dnspython, python-dotenv.
